notes.title: Behind the Scene Part 3
notes.notes:
Hello best valets,
 
A huge thank you to each and every one of you – you are a vital part of this adventure! 🙏💖 

For us, two friends with a dream, seeing your support means the world.  Your engagement pushes us to make the game even better and to keep delivering exciting content. 

New improvements and features based on your feedback for the Full Version.


[b]Repair – a strategic mini-game[/b] 🛠️

The new repair mechanic adds an exciting dimension: you can now repair cars to earn extra money. But repairs also carry a risk – there’s a chance that a part will break, costing you money. You’ll need to carefully weigh whether the repair is worth it or not. This feature brings not only variety to the gameplay but also a tactical element, presenting you with new challenges. 🔧

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/ffcf488d65bddbe222bc71f89e244fd6e6495d66.gif[/img]

[b]Refueling made easier – now simpler than ever[/b] ⛽

We’ve added and revamped the refueling process to make it more intuitive and straightforward. With an improved interface and clearer mechanics, you can now refuel vehicles quickly and precisely. This feature will be especially useful in those hectic moments when every second counts. We can’t wait to see how this improvement affects your gameplay experience. 🚗💨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/50e17d5bf970d4096280f2e4d51fca960b1f6697.gif[/img]

[b]New customer characters for more variety [/b]

Meet with more our new customers. To make the world of the game more lively and exciting, we are working on a range of new customer characters. We want to share a few of them here!

But that’s not all! We are planning to choose the new store owner on our Discord server. Your opinion matters, and we invite you to actively participate in this decision. 🗳️ We will share the characters on 13 Dec on Discord channel. Invite link is [url=https://discord.gg/rEZYjRuDd3]here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/347ed2938c897915ba83fdba55012bf0e0f07827.gif[/img]

[b]Join our community on Discord[/b] 🎮 Invite link is [url=https://discord.gg/rEZYjRuDd3]here[/url]

Our Discord server has recently been revamped and now offers even more ways to connect with us and other players. You can share your ideas, discuss the game, and stay updated on upcoming features. We are also excited to introduce our new Discord Designer, who will welcome you on the server and ensure everything runs smoothly. 🎨

Your contributions, feedback, and creativity are invaluable to us. Together with you, we want to not only continue developing the game but also build a strong and lively community. 🤝

We’re just getting started, and there are many exciting updates and challenges ahead. Your feedback is the driving force behind everything we do, and we’re committed to continuously improving the game. From the core gameplay to the smallest details, everything we do is aimed at providing you with the best gaming experience possible. 🚀
Image
Thank you! 🙏

We want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your loyalty and support. You make this project truly special, and we can’t wait to take the next steps with you. 💖


We look forward to continuing this adventure with you and bringing out the best in our game. 🎮

Cheers
Valet Team 🚗💨

notes.title: Behind the Scene Part 2
notes.notes:
We’re beyond excited to share that our game is about to surpass 15,000 players! 🎊 A huge thank you to each and every one of you for playing, sharing your experiences, and supporting us on this amazing journey.

We’re just two friends who dreamed up this game, and seeing your support means the world to us. We’re watching your videos, reading your feedback, and constantly inspired to make the game even better. 💪

You can also connect with us on Discord—we’d love to chat with you there! (Invite link [url=https://discord.com/invite/3u5P9f4QCq]here[/url])

[h2]New Updates:[/h2]
[h3]Meet Arthur![/h3] 🧑‍🔧 Our very first employee is here! Arthur will help manage the chaos by driving cars for you and saving precious time. And guess what? Arthur is just the beginning—there will be six different employees for you to hire, each bringing unique skills to your team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/852af7ea61e0227172eb34fc402bb0f63f3ca3b8.png[/img]

Many of you found the transition from managing one building to two a real challenge—Arthur is here to help with that!
Some of you mentioned the gameplay felt repetitive. This is because the prologue is focused on showcasing the core parking mechanic. But don’t worry, there’s so much more to come!

Arthur is amazing! You can see what is like to have 3 Arthurs below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/36b3632bd86d24ef853d8522f3434476f4e21c01.gif[/img]

[h3]Customer Tips & Needs:[/h3]

Customers will vary in generosity—choose wisely who to serve! Some of them will give high tips!
New features are coming, such as car repairs, refueling, engine oil changes, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/3d51367c8b6b5415b6998677a1ab29d035f91deb.gif[/img]

[h3]Workbench & Repairs:[/h3]

Our repair system is ready! You’ll be able to fix cars using a fun 2D mini-game and earn extra income. We can’t wait for you to try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/8c6cbdc1d0754469e7fddba07b31255062b1901f.gif[/img]

[h2]Discord[/h2]
Stay tuned for more updates, and join the conversation on Discord—our awesome first moderator, He  set up the channel and is ready to welcome you all. 🚀

🔗 Join Our Discord [url=https://discord.com/invite/3u5P9f4QCq]Here[/url]

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your support fuels us to keep building! 🚗💨

Cheers,
The Dev Team

notes.title: Valet Simulator - Behind the Scenes
notes.notes:
Hey Best Drivers! 😀

We are two passionate friends working hard to bring you an engaging and enjoyable valet simulation experience. Our goal is to create a fun and immersive game that you'll love.

Starting today, we'll be sharing regular updates on our progress right here. Stay tuned for the latest news, features, and behind-the-scenes insights as we continue to develop our game. Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and we can't wait to take this journey together with you.

[h3]Company Name Customization [/h3]

This week, we’ve enhanced the ability to customize your company's name. You can now choose your company's name, edit word and character spacing, and even add outlines and different color options to make it truly unique!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/cdde42cd33ba3d8584f6be570b3c6a76d053f263.gif[/img]

[h3]Parking Area Decoration[/h3]

You can now add trees, street lamps, and flowers to your parking area. These additions will not only beautify your space but also help you earn more. We're planning to introduce even more variants soon, so stay tuned for updates!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/bfab04e60ab3b19ca5f87e917dc3dc6ddd5eeadf.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45088954/bfab04e60ab3b19ca5f87e917dc3dc6ddd5eeadf.gif[/img][/url]

We’re working hard on more features that are almost ready to be revealed. We’ll be sharing those details here, so keep an eye out for our next update.

PS: Check out the last image for some spoilers!

Thank you for your continued support!
